products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as providing trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates as an independent entity offering a portfolio of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular data management, health data analytics, and real-world evidence services.

Its product lineup includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution aimed at providing clinicians with point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform built for clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, which includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Truven is offered as a health data analytics and consulting product, and the company also provides a real-world evidence portfolio of data, services, and applications. One customer account cited on the company's site references an improvement from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, along with 36,000 hours in time savings and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings in a single cohort.

The site's held facts classify Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting its focus on healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
